name: drivr
description: DRIVR helps people in Tunisia find, compare and rent cars. Search the live catalog of new cars sold in Tunisia by brand, model, body type, fuel, transmission and price in TND; get specs and recent price changes; compare up to four cars; discover similar models and the best current deals; and find rental cars by city and daily budget with the agency's WhatsApp and phone contact. Limitations: Tunisia only; new cars and rental offers only (no used cars); DRIVR does not take bookings or payments — rentals are arranged directly with the agency.
